featured_reviews.name: Arpit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Don't think of this as a blessing in disguise. I had a horrific experience even trying to apply for admission into the hostel. I had requested stay for just 2 months for my summer internship and was asked to fill up a 9 page application form. If you don't have a local guardian in Mumbai, they won't admit you in. They physically want to interview you and your parents for admission. If your parents are old and not able to make it in person for the interview, they reject your application. No transparent reason will be given for the rejection. For anybody travelling from other states, there is no consideration of an online interview or interview in person(without parents). For admission into a hostel, they need your entire family history: parents' aadhaar, their pan cards, your loan documents(if any), your marksheets, your college fee receipts, cancelled cheques. Not sure if they are admitting into a hostel or giving us a job at NASA.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very unpleasant experience during my 2-month stay here for my summer internship. The room was extremely dirty, and the entire place was infested with cockroaches — including inside the cupboards. Cleanliness was clearly not a priority.

The owner is not honest and seems to be only interested in extracting money. He follows his own set of rules, often unreasonable, and without any prior notice. A standard practice appears to be cutting ₹2000 or more from your security deposit without valid explanation.

Overall, staying here felt like a nightmare. It was stressful, unhygienic, and completely opposite of what a PG should be. I strongly advise others not to stay here, especially if you value your peace of mind, money, and basic hygiene.

featured_reviews.name: Axar Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dishonest and Unprofessional PG Owner – Not Recommended at All!

I had a very disappointing experience with this PG. I had paid ₹1000 in advance to confirm my booking, but the owner completely refused to refund the amount after I decided not to move in. Before payment, they were very polite and responsive, but once the money was received, their attitude completely changed.

Despite multiple follow-ups and polite requests, the owner kept making excuses and finally stopped responding to my messages and calls. This shows a serious lack of professionalism and honesty. ₹1000 may not be a big amount for some, but it clearly reflects how they treat tenants and handle commitments.

If you are looking for a genuine and transparent PG, I strongly advise you to avoid this place. Always ask for written confirmation or receipts before paying any advance here — otherwise, you might end up being cheated like me.

Highly disappointed with such unethical behavior. I hope others don’t face the same issue.
